newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni raises key rate to 24.6 pct (12.3).
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni raises key rate to 24.6 pct (12.3).

text.p: The largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s., said on Monday that it would raise its key reference rate on credit to 24.6 percent effective on Tuesday, from 12.3 percent.

In a statement, spokeswoman Irena Satavova said the bank would also raise its base rate to 21.7 percent from 10.85 percent reflecting a massive rise in rates on the interbank market following recent central bank moves.
